breakdown.description: The solver is labelled plane stress, but the constitutive relation switches to the unreduced 2D/3D Lamé law
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly instructs to use the unreduced 3D Lamé law ('Do not apply any plane-stress reduction to the constitutive law; use the standard 3D isotropic Lame form directly') and uses lmbda = E*nu/((1+nu)*(1-2*nu)), which is the 3D form. The ground truth requires the reduced plane-stress constitutive law. The agent repeated the original error rather than correcting it.
